PetName82_Desc: A cat that somehow resembles Momo. It hides only its head beneath a handkerchief and seems convinced that no one can see it. Think twice before carrying off the whole basket just because it looks cute: a paw punch faster than light may come flying your way.

PetName85_Desc: A magical doll modeled after Shoupan, Elias's undisputed express courier. She loves racing at exhilarating speeds. She often crashes into things or damages her deliveries, but they say she moves far too fast for anyone to catch her.
